paper_metadata.title: Oxidation Behavior of Mo Containing Alloys

evidence.quote: In this study, high temperature (T>500 oC) oxidation behavior of two commercial Ni-base alloys and two experimental alloys, all containing more than 10% Molybdenum, is investigated.
Also, preliminary results of the oxidation studies conducted on the experimental Mo-base alloys are presented.
